SELECT 1 FROM `stage_review` AS NEW WHERE COALESCE((length(NEW.date)=10 AND length(NEW.effects_json)>=2 AND (NEW.smoking IS NULL OR NEW.smoking IN ('YES','NO')) AND (NEW.systolic IS NULL OR (NEW.systolic>0 AND NEW.systolic<1000)) AND (NEW.diastolic IS NULL OR (NEW.diastolic>0 AND NEW.diastolic<1000)) AND (NEW.weight_kg IS NULL OR (NEW.weight_kg>0 AND NEW.weight_kg<=1.7976931348623157e308)) AND (NEW.satisfaction IS NULL OR NEW.satisfaction BETWEEN 1 AND 5)),0)=0 LIMIT 1

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(length(CAST(`date` AS BLOB)),0)+COALESCE(length(CAST(`effects_json` AS BLOB)),0)+COALESCE(length(CAST(`tolerance_note` AS BLOB)),0)+COALESCE(length(CAST(`risk_note` AS BLOB)),0)+COALESCE(length(CAST(`smoking` AS BLOB)),0)+COALESCE(length(CAST(`satisfaction_note` AS BLOB)),0)),0),COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN `id` IS NOT NULL AND NOT (typeof(`id`)='integer') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0),COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN `date` IS NOT NULL AND NOT (typeof(`date`)='text' AND length(`date`)<=1048576) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0),COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN `effects_json` IS NOT NULL AND NOT (typeof(`effects_json`)='text' AND length(`effects_json`)<=1048576) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0),COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN `tolerance_note` IS NOT NULL AND NOT (typeof(`tolerance_note`)='text' AND length(`tolerance_note`)<=1048576) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0),COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN `risk_note` IS NOT NULL AND NOT (typeof(`risk_note`)='text' AND length(`risk_note`)<=1048576) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0),COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN `smoking` IS NOT NULL AND NOT (typeof(`smoking`)='text' AND length(`smoking`)<=1048576) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0),COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN `systolic` IS NOT NULL AND NOT (typeof(`systolic`)='integer') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0),COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN `diastolic` IS NOT NULL AND NOT (typeof(`diastolic`)='integer') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0),COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN `weight_kg` IS NOT NULL AND NOT (typeof(`weight_kg`) IN ('integer','real') AND `weight_kg` BETWEEN -1.7976931348623157e308 AND 1.7976931348623157e308) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0),COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN `satisfaction` IS NOT NULL AND NOT (typeof(`satisfaction`)='integer') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0),COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN `satisfaction_note` IS NOT NULL AND NOT (typeof(`satisfaction_note`)='text' AND length(`satisfaction_note`)<=1048576) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) FROM `stage_review`
